title: Pi smoke test: prove a real tick runs end to end on pi/GLM-5.3 under herdr
description:
A throwaway tick whose only purpose is to prove the routing works: dispatched through tk herd spawn --tier frontier, run by pi on cloudflare GLM-5.3, committing and reporting like any other worker.

Do exactly this and nothing else:
1. Read .tick/learnings.md and .tick/config.md from your worktree.
2. Append one line to .tick/learnings.md under 'Orchestration', in the file's existing Problem/Rule shape, recording something TRUE that you can verify about this repository. Keep it under the 150-line cap.
3. Commit it.
4. Write RESULT-<your-tick-id>.md ending with a STATUS line.

Do not touch anything else. Do not run the full test suite; this tick changes no Go code.
acceptance_criteria: One commit that appends a single Problem/Rule entry to .tick/learnings.md, the file stays under its 150-line cap, and RESULT ends with STATUS: DONE.
closed_reason: Pi smoke test passed. Dispatched via tk herd spawn --tier frontier, run by pi on cloudflare GLM-5.3, committed 59e4392 adding a true learnings entry (a bare go test dies at the default 10-minute per-package timeout because internal/reconcile alone takes ~600s under -short; run through the Makefile, which pins 45m). Merged. The whole loop works on GLM 5.3: dispatch, worktree, commit, report.
